paragraphs: The F-Type V6 S uses the AJ126 — a 3.0-litre supercharged V6 petrol engine. It was fitted from the F-Type's launch in 2012 through to 2024 across the X152 generation, sitting above the 2.0-litre Ingenium four-cylinder and below the 5.0-litre supercharged V8 in the F-Type range.
about.boldParagraph: The V6 S was discontinued alongside the rest of the F-Type range in 2024, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre supercharged V6 fitted to the F-Type V6 S from 2012 to 2024 (X152 generation). No widely-reported specific known issue confirmed for this application — we still service it to the same standard as our other Jaguar rebuilds, replacing timing chain, tensioners and guides as standard where worn.
